verdict.rationale: Digits ships a built-in AI assistant, Ask Digits, described as "Your AI financial assistant". It answers questions about the user's financials and has a documented task mode ("Ask questions. Complete tasks." / "Ask Digits to Get it Done"). The in-product Agentic Close and AI bookkeeping also do work for the user rather than only recording it. Missing for 10: specifics on which tasks Ask Digits can actually carry out (write actions, approvals, limits), in-depth docs on the task mode, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
